people.name: Mumon Yamada (山田 無文, Yamada Mumon)

relations.subject: Mumon Yamada (山田 無文, Yamada Mumon)
relations.evidence: Mumon Yamada (山田 無文, Yamada Mumon; July 16, 1900 – December 24, 1988) was a Rinzai roshi, calligrapher, and former abbot of Shōfuku-ji in Kobe, Japan.
